title: Posterior Groin Anatomy for Inguinal Hernia Repair
subtitle: Evidence-based learning from landmark publications
description: Master the posterior view of the groin through six carefully curated papers. Each module offers a unique perspective on anatomy and technique for laparoscopic and robotic inguinal hernia repair.

papers.shortTitle: Furtado et al. — Inverted Y & Five Triangles
papers.fullTitle: Anatomical landmarks in robotic-assisted transabdominal preperitoneal inguinal hernia repair
papers.bestFor: Building your mental map of posterior anatomy

papers.shortTitle: Yang et al. — Preperitoneal Spaces & Fascial Planes
papers.fullTitle: Fascial planes of the groin and their application to robotic transabdominal preperitoneal inguinal hernia repair
papers.bestFor: Understanding tissue planes and dissection mechanics

papers.shortTitle: Yasukawa et al. — Crucial Anatomy & Technical Cues
papers.fullTitle: Anatomical landmarks and intraoperative decisions in laparoscopic transabdominal preperitoneal repair
papers.bestFor: Connecting anatomical knowledge to surgical decisions

papers.shortTitle: Daes & Felix — Critical View of the MPO
papers.fullTitle: Critical view of the myopectineal orifice: A unified anatomical concept for inguinal hernia repair
papers.bestFor: Establishing the safety endpoint for dissection

papers.shortTitle: Claus et al. — Ten Golden Rules of the MPO
papers.fullTitle: Ten golden rules for a safe MIS inguinal hernia repair using a new anatomical concept

papers.shortTitle: Ramser et al. — rTAPP Video-Based Anatomy
papers.fullTitle: Step-by-step approach to robotic transabdominal preperitoneal inguinal hernia repair
papers.bestFor: Seeing anatomy unfold during the procedure
